summary: Lower `#name in obj` to a JavaScript private-brand test with the required RHS object check.

target.notes: Check that the RHS is an object and then test the defining private brand without reading the private value.

caveats: This is not equivalent to string-key membership such as `"#x" in obj`.

tests.name: brand present
tests.input: class C { #x; static has(o){ return #x in o; } } console.log(C.has(new C()));

tests.name: edge: primitive RHS throws
tests.input: class C { #x; static has(o){ return #x in o; } } C.has(1);
